clause_text: Employee shall not compete with Company or its affiliates on a worldwide basis for a period of 3 years following termination of employment.
You agree not to engage in any competitive activity anywhere in India for 2 years after leaving.
Non-compete restricted to Mumbai city limits for 6 months after termination.
Employee shall not join any competing firm globally for 18 months post-termination.
Employee agrees not to work for a competitor within the local district for 3 months.
Employee assigns to Company all work product including inventions developed on personal time using personal equipment outside working hours.
All inventions created by employee during employment are assigned to Company with no carveout for prior inventions.
IP assignment is limited to inventions made within scope of employment and related to company business. Prior inventions listed in Schedule A are excluded.
Employee assigns all work product including those created using personal equipment on personal time outside business hours.
All inventions developed using company resources are assigned to employer. Pre-existing IP is excluded via Schedule A.
Employer may terminate by giving employee 7 days notice. Employee must give employer 90 days notice of resignation.
Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice.
Employer may terminate immediately and without notice for any breach.
Company may terminate with 15 days notice. Employee must provide 60 days notice.
Agreement terminates automatically on expiry of the term unless renewed by mutual written consent.
Confidentiality obligations shall remain in force in perpetuity with no limitation of time.
Employee shall keep all confidential information secret forever without any carveout for publicly available information.
Confidentiality obligations apply for 2 years post-termination. Standard carveouts apply for publicly known information.
All proprietary information must remain confidential indefinitely with no exceptions.
Confidential information shall be protected for 3 years. Information in the public domain is excluded.
Company shall not be liable under any circumstances. No liability whatsoever for any damages.
Liability is capped at one month of fees paid in the preceding 30 days.
Each party's liability is capped at 12 months of fees. Mutual limitation applies to both parties.
Vendor's total liability shall not exceed zero rupees under any conditions.
Liability limited to direct damages only, capped at 6 months of contract value.
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales. Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration seated in London.
Governing law is the laws of India. Courts at Bangalore shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
This contract is governed by Singapore law and disputes resolved by SIAC arbitration in Singapore.
Agreement governed by laws of Delaware, USA. Federal courts of New York shall have jurisdiction.
Governed by the laws of Republic of India. Mumbai courts have exclusive jurisdiction.
Employee shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company against all claims, losses, and expenses.
Mutual indemnification clause. Each party indemnifies the other for its own negligence.
Employee must indemnify Company for any claim arising out of employee's work including personal liability.
All disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration in Mumbai under Indian Arbitration Act.
Disputes resolved by arbitration in Singapore under ICC rules. Seat of arbitration is Singapore.
Parties agree to mediation before arbitration. Any unresolved dispute goes to Delhi courts.
Salary shall be paid monthly. Company reserves right to modify compensation without notice.
Fees are payable within 30 days of invoice. Late payments attract 1.5% monthly interest.
Compensation is subject to change at sole discretion of employer with no minimum guarantee.
Employee shall not solicit any Company clients or employees for 2 years after termination worldwide.
Employee shall not recruit Company employees for 12 months post-termination within the same city.
Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform due to force majeure events including pandemic, natural disaster, or act of god.
Only employer is excused from performance during force majeure. Employee obligations continue uninterrupted.
Employee accepts unlimited liability for any breach of this agreement without any cap or limitation.
Contractor's liability for IP infringement is uncapped and unlimited in all circumstances.
Vendor warrants that deliverables will conform to specifications for 90 days post-delivery.
All work is provided AS IS with no warranty of any kind expressed or implied.
Company may share employee personal data with third parties without consent for any business purpose.
Personal data processed only for employment purposes and not shared with third parties without consent.
Company may assign this agreement to any successor entity without employee consent.
Neither party may assign this agreement without prior written consent of the other party.
Agreement auto-renews annually unless terminated with 90 days written notice.
Contract expires on the end date. No automatic renewal. Continuation requires new agreement.
No severance shall be paid upon termination for any reason whatsoever.
Employee receives 2 months severance pay on termination without cause.
Client may audit vendor's systems and records at any time without prior notice.
Audit rights limited to financial records with 30 days advance written notice. Once per year maximum.
